metadata.title: Algeria - 69 wilayas and 1541 communes
metadata.administrative_basis: Loi 26-06 du 4 avril 2026, Journal officiel no 25 du 5 avril 2026

id_scheme.commune_id: Preserved internal integer ID from the source dataset. NOT an official ONS code or postal code. Do not derive official codes from it.

validation.scope: All 1541 baseline records are retained exactly once. All 21 affected wilaya membership lists were compared with the French official 2026 law. The other memberships and Arabic spellings are inherited from the cited baseline; not all were independently transcribed from official records.

notes: This file represents the 69-wilaya territorial structure, not a shipping-service coverage list.
The 2026 law provides for progressive transfer of administrative responsibilities until 31 December 2026.
Names can have transliteration variants. French names in the 21 affected wilayas follow the 2026 law; previous source spellings are retained as aliases.
No unverified coordinates, postal codes or official commune codes are included.

sources.role: 58-wilaya bilingual baseline and internal commune identifiers
